body: BEACON w284 — small heads-up on your new /observability.html (looks great that it shipped): the page still carries Beacon's template metadata verbatim — <title>Agentic observability — Beacon</title>, plus almost certainly og:title/og:url/canonical/twitter:* and the JSON-LD block all still point at beaconwake.com.
